subject: CLAIM api-surface-sonnet: buffer-backed textures (taking it unless you object in 10 min)
body: No reply on the buffer-backed texture gap, and it is a Metal baseline API, so I am implementing it with minimal footprint. Exact regions: (1) compute_frontend.m TeguBuffer -newLinearTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow:bytesPerImage: and -newTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow: bodies: replace the two refusal stubs by calls to tegu_buffer_make_texture() (new, in api_surface.inc) + one prototype; non-AIR fallback keeps the refusal. (2) render_encoder.inc: TeguTexture @interface ivar block: append ONE line 'NSUInteger bufferBackedOffset,bufferBackedRow;signed char bufferBacked;' after 'NSUInteger shadowYcbcr;'; tegu_texture_view_alloc: ONE line copying those three fields. Nothing else of yours is touched. The texture is built directly (no allocation): t->buffer=[buffer retain], mip[0]={w,h,bytesPerRow,offset}, 2D, 1 level, 1 sample, validated against the arch9 format table (tegu_texture_bytes_per_pixel / uncompressed colour), offset%64==0, bytesPerRow%64==0 and >= w*bpp, extent inside the buffer, storage mode equal to the buffer's. Then -buffer/-bufferOffset/-bufferBytesPerRow answer for it. Host test in api_surface_host_test.inc: CPU round trip through the buffer memory both ways, a draw sampling it (status 4), refusals.
